The plate looks like a side plate, roughly 20 cm across. It holds about 6 raspberries and 5 blackberries, plus a few crumbs.

Raspberries weigh about 4-5 g each, so 6 come to roughly 28 g. The blackberries are large, about 8 g each, so 5 come to roughly 40 g. The crumbs add about 2 g. That gives a total of about 70 g.

Berries run about 0.5 kcal/g, so 70 g is roughly 35-40 kcal.
